services._note: runsvdir notices a newly linked service only on its next scan (every 5 s), and until its runsv is up sv fails ('unable to open supervise/control', or 'runsv not running' when an old supervise/ directory is left from before): start and restart wait up to 15 s for sv status to answer.
services.start: i=0; while [ -L /run/runit/service/{service_name} ] && ! env SVDIR=/run/runit/service sv status {service_name} >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $i -lt 15 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; env SVDIR=/run/runit/service sv start {service_name}
services.restart: i=0; while [ -L /run/runit/service/{service_name} ] && ! env SVDIR=/run/runit/service sv status {service_name} >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ $i -lt 15 ]; do sleep 1; i=$((i+1)); done; env SVDIR=/run/runit/service sv restart {service_name}
